paidskills_skill_respec:
This will remove the $skill_name; skill.

It will return $refund_points; points and refund $refund_cash_perc;% of cash invested.
paidskills_tree_respec:
You are about to respec this skill tree.

Doing a respec resets all skill points in the $skill_tree; skill tree.
You will also be refunded $refund_cash_perc;% of your investments in this tree.
paidskills_all_trees_respec:
You are about to respec all skill trees.

Doing a respec resets all skill points.
You will also be refunded $refund_cash_perc;% of cash invested across all skill trees.
paidskills_settings_no_confirmation_desc: Disable confirmation dialogs when adding/removing skills and resetting skill trees.
